items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: The interviewee mentions Bunk in the context of a story about Sydney Bechet ('when Bunk took his band to Stuyvesant...') and notes that 'all the old-timers like Bunk once said he was the greatest' referring to Sidney Bechet.
